info.name: LOD authority_search search and access API

params.name: format
params.description: set the Content-Type over this Query-Parameter. Allowed: nt, rdf, ttl, nq, jsonl, json

params.name: sort
params.description: how to sort the returned datasets. like: path_to_property:[asc|desc]

params.name: size
params.description: Configure the maxmimum amount of hits to be returned

params.name: from
params.description: Configure the offset from the frist result you want to fetch

params.name: filter
params.description: filter the search by a defined value in a path. e.g. path_to_property:value

params.name: entity_type
params.description: The name of the entity-type to access. Allowed Values: ['organizations', 'persons', 'resources', 'works', 'events', 'topics', 'geo'].
